title: BC26 Noisy-Student SED student NFNet (soundscape-adapted)
subtitle: eca_nfnet_l0 234-head trained on distilled-SED pseudo-labeled train_soundscapes (Nikita noisy-student) - ensemble diversity member
description:
Noisy-student SED student for BirdCLEF+ 2026, eca_nfnet_l0 backbone. A DIVERSITY member of a Nikita-style heterogeneous ensemble: a genuinely different architecture (NFNet, ScaledStdConv + ECA attention, ~22M params) from the tf_efficientnet_b0 / effv2s students, so its soundscape predictions are orthogonal and add ensemble lift.

Domain-adapts a mel-CNN from FOCAL train_audio to the SOUNDSCAPE test domain (the fix for round-0's 0.944<0.950 regression).

TEACHER: distilled-SED ONNX ensemble (tuckerarrants/bc2026-distilled-sed-public, 5 folds) on the unlabeled train_soundscapes. (The public Perch v2 ONNX exposes only a generic 14,795-class head, NOT the 234-class space, so it cannot contribute 234-class pseudo-labels and is omitted.)

RECIPE (Nikita Babych 2025 #1, identical to the b0 student for a fair diversity comparison): pure power-transform soft pseudo-labels (threshold=0, per-round power 1.0/1.54), MANDATORY fixed-lambda=0.5 MixUp of every sample with a random pseudo soundscape sample, soft cross-entropy, AdamW lr 5e-4 cosine, AMP, channels_last, 2 rounds, ~4000 soundscapes + focal anchors. Multi-round: the student re-labels the soundscapes and becomes the next teacher.

FILES:
  - ns_student_nfnet_fold1_fp16.pt : eca_nfnet_l0 state_dict (fp16) + classes(234) + config.
  - ns_student_nfnet_soundscape_preds.parquet : student soft preds on all soundscape windows (for orthogonality/quality check vs the b0 student and the 0.950 base).

Blend onto the proven 0.950 EoS9 base by rank-blend.
